Total ≈ 155 kcal, with about 160 g of food.

**STEP 7 - Uncertainty:** Greens 35–90 g, salmon 35–70 g, fruit 15–45 g, tomato/pepper 3–10 g, shredded veg 5–15 g, dressing 2–10 g. Total plausible range is about 110–230 g.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 160 g fits a visible plate of salad with one modest protein portion. The salmon and dressing are the main energy sources. The estimate is consistent with the volumes, so no adjustment is needed.
